intent: Aliveness campaign Wave-0 PR-2 (A4+A5), loop-closure lane: the only liveness surface, ~/.dharma/ops/loop_liveness.json, is overwritten in place by orchestrate_live.py _write_loop_liveness (tmp.replace), so an unattended run leaves zero replayable uptime evidence, and no process-level boot identity exists anywhere in dharma_swarm/ (git grep boot_id at base: zero hits), making P4 restart survival unprovable (docs/plans/LOOP1_CLOSURE_SPEC_2026-07-11.md P4). This packet adds: a single-mint process boot_id in dharma_swarm/spine/identity.py; a durable appender in orchestrate_live.py that writes digest-chained spine VerifiedMachineReceipt rows (boot_id, pid, running, restart_counts, abandoned) to ~/.dharma/ops/liveness_ledger.jsonl hourly and on abandonment change, reusing spine/receipt.py append_machine_receipt (one receipt format, one digest formula); a read-only replay verifier scripts/governance/liveness_ledger_check.py that exits typed needs_host(0) when the ledger is absent and 1 on broken chain or failed coverage; a live_ops_census.py dharma_daemon pattern fix so the census can match the container entrypoint python -m dharma_swarm.orchestrate_live (Dockerfile.swarm CMD) that the CLI-only pattern could never see; tests; and the loop-closure next_item admission. No scheduling changes (census cron waits on BR-004 reconciliation), no hot-loop semantics changed, evidence-append failures never propagate into the supervision loop.

commit.message: feat(loop-closure): durable liveness ledger, boot_id, replay verifier (WP-A4A5)

interface_mismatches: scripts/runtime/live_ops_census.py PROCESS_PATTERNS['dharma_daemon'] matched only the dgc_cli spelling while Dockerfile.swarm CMD boots python -m dharma_swarm.orchestrate_live, so the census reported the daemon dead on every containerized host; fixed in this packet by extending the pattern to both launch spellings (not added to INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md because it is fixed in the same change).
honest_blockers: The host legs of A4/A5 stay open by design: >=24 chained hourly rows under one boot_id need 24h on a booted host, and the cross-restart different-boot_id proof needs the operator's single deliberate restart (WP-LC2); this packet ships only the producer, the mint, and the CI-safe verifier (needs_host on this seat).

Hourly census scheduling (the A4 secondary witness) is deliberately NOT wired: cron job config is frozen behind the BR-004 pulse-fork reconciliation (pulse.py executes handler jobs as headless LLM prompts), so scheduling before that fix would be theater.

The full tests/test_orchestrate_live.py suite cannot run as a packet gate: the admission jail interpreter lacks pytest-asyncio, so its four pre-existing async tests fail collection there (verified in the first closeout report). The packet gates pin the three synchronous tests this change adds; the full suite is adjudicated by the hosted pytest (3.11/3.12) CI contexts, mirroring the WP-O8 venv-sensitivity precedent.

The ruff gate cannot name dharma_swarm/orchestrate_live.py: its stem normalizes to a banned live-command token in the gate grammar (contract.py _BANNED_LIVE_COMMAND_TOKENS), so that file is linted by the repo-wide CI lint instead of a packet gate.
If origin/main moves past base 3482cdfa before merge, this packet must be re-minted (base_ref, collision sha, negative-control shas, digest).
session_entry.rollback: revert the spine boot_id mint, the orchestrate_live ledger appender and its tick wiring, the replay verifier, the census pattern extension, the three test additions, the loop-closure next_item 11, and this packet together; the overwrite-in-place liveness gap and the zero-hit boot_id grep then reproduce at will.
